jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, plays a significant role in AWS's success with developing Graviton servers.
Graviton servers are ARM-based processors that provide better performance and cost-effectiveness for running various compute-intensive applications on the cloud.
As a Software Test Development Engineer in our team, you will be responsible for the Graviton servers' software quality.
That includes setting up and maintenance of lab and cloud environments, writing test-plans, automating them and troubleshooting issues.
You will take part in designing, developing, and maintaining our automation frameworks and will work closely with developers to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality Graviton servers to our customers.
As a part of this team, you will solve difficult technical problems, work on test frameworks, test tools, and test case automation for large components. You will build and apply solutions that assess and mitigate quality risks on the Graviton servers.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about ensuring the quality of embedded firmware that powers millions of cloud instances worldwide? Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, develops the Nitro card — a dedicated hardware component with powerful processing capabilities and specialized ASICs that operates independently from the main system board running customer compute environments. Each Nitro card runs multiple layers of embedded firmware, from real-time microcontroller management processors to SoC-level boot and runtime software, all of which must meet the highest reliability and security standards before reaching production.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test on our team, you will own the quality of Nitro card embedded software and firmware. You will design, develop, and maintain test automation for embedded systems and components, covering hardware interface verification, real-time firmware behavior validation, firmware update integrity, and fleet-scale deployment confidence. You will collaborate closely with firmware development teams to troubleshoot complex system-level problems at the hardware-software boundary and ensure timely delivery of high-quality Nitro card software to AWS Cloud solutions.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the firmware test automation framework — architect, develop, and extend a Python-based validation solution that scales across multiple Nitro card generations and hardware platforms, automating test coverage across the full firmware stack
